notes.title: Music Update V0.1
notes.content:
New stuff

Added the first version of the music mode, this is a very early version so please give lots of feedback
Added controller vibration when cutting. this works in both BPM mode and Music.
Added a way to convert BeatSaber tracks to slicer tracks.


Track conversions
THIS IS ONLY FOR YOU TO IMPORT YOU OWN TACK. TACKS THAT YOU HAVE MADE
Inside the sliicer\Project Slicer_Data\StreamingAssets\BS folder is where you place songs to be converted. This does the conversion when loading into the music mode so it will freeze the game, just wait while it does it thing.

There is a way of setting up the files to be converted. that main thing is to rename the difficulty file you want to main.dat
So the files you need are
[olist]
song.ogg or song.egg
info.dat
main.dat
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40521867/64bba3a6ede5c8f8a4a68a903b0ca48d27a249d5.png


I included a example song, but this will be changed in the future.

Also if you make music and would love to help me out, hit me up!

Join the discord for any help and for giving feedback
Join!

Once that is done the plan is to submit it for publishing, with the hope to work on game dev stuff full time.
